name: Helheim
slug: Home of goliaths who hold a peace treaty with the giants, which the party was asked to steal and never visited.
description: Helheim is home to people described as goliaths who have a peace treaty with the giants.

log.summary: Nyx Cage offered the party a discount on heat stones if they went to Helheim and stole a peace treaty between its people, described as goliaths, and the giants. The party did not take the job and did not go.
notes: Destination of the untaken job for Nyx Cage: steal a peace treaty between the people of Helheim, described as goliaths, and the giants. The party did not go.
